candidates.title: Prepare due-date reminder drafts from a sheet

demandEvidence.chore: Connect Google Sheets rows through Make Search Rows to automate reminders based on stored due dates.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to connect Google Sheets to my Make scenario using the Search Rows module so I can automate reminders based on due dates stored in a spreadsheet.

ease.reason: A beginner can try operator-supplied sample rows, but no supplied reference supports the spreadsheet connection or reminder delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent workflow consultants might pay to configure deadline reminders; this one request proves neither a buyer nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can turn synthetic due-date rows into reminder drafts; live spreadsheet access and delivery remain unsupported.

autonomy.reason: A proposed workflow could prepare drafts after a test trigger, but a person must verify dates, recipients and any sending.

evidence.reason: The request explicitly names Search Rows and reminders from spreadsheet due dates, but gives no implementation or repeat-use evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow proposed test that reads operator-supplied synthetic due-date rows and prepares reminder drafts for human review. No supplied implementation reference supports the connection or delivery, leaving the provisional mean below the 6 threshold.

rejected.title: Offer an analytics alternative
rejected.reason: The excerpt questions whether analytics serves customers and says to use something else, but does not identify a bounded repeated task suitable for an AI service.

rejected.title: Review coding-agent changes as a map
rejected.reason: This post is a product launch title, not evidence of an existing unmet chore; the described code-review workflow also duplicates recent post 0d455200b5ff2b5b39d4eac6.

rejected.title: Recover a locked workflow account
rejected.reason: The request concerns restoring privileged account access and preserving existing workflows. An automated recovery experiment lacks safe implementation support and could risk data loss.

rejected.title: Prepare due-date reminder drafts from a sheet
rejected.reason: A bounded synthetic-row reminder experiment was assessed, but its provisional five-criterion mean is below 6; no supplied implementation reference supports the connection or delivery.

rejected.title: Send weekly keyword volumes to a sheet
rejected.reason: The readable excerpt establishes only a Monday schedule; it does not identify the keyword retrieval or spreadsheet task, so those duties cannot be inferred.

rejected.title: Capture and qualify incoming leads
rejected.reason: The post says its author built a lead-capture workflow, but does not state an external request or unmet chore. It therefore cannot establish demand for a proposed service.

rejected.title: Draft replies to frequent customer queries
rejected.reason: This overlaps recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6 on the support-inbox workflow and customer-query handling; adding human approval does not make it distinct.
